using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task LogsError_WhenSyncFromAofAddressLessThanBeginAddress_AndNoAofDataLoss()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(null, null, null);
            var appendOnlyFileMock = new Mock<AppendOnlyFile>(); // Simplified mock
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(s => s.appendOnlyFile).Returns(appendOnlyFileMock.Object);
            appendOnlyFileMock.Setup(a => a.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);

            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(null, null, null, null);
            clusterProviderMock.Setup(c => c.serverOptions.UseAofNullDevice).Returns(false);
            clusterProviderMock.Setup(c => c.serverOptions.FastAofTruncate).Returns(false);
            clusterProviderMock.Setup(c => c.serverOptions.OnDemandCheckpoint).Returns(true);

            var gcsMock = new Mock<GarnetClientSession>(null, null, null, null, null, null, null);
            gcsMock.Setup(g => g.ExecuteBeginReplicaRecover(
                It.IsAny<bool>(),
                It.IsAny<bool>(),
                It.IsAny<bool>(),
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<byte[]>(),
                It.IsAny<long>(),
                It.IsAny<long>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("50"); // syncFromAofAddress < beginAddress

            var localEntryMock = new Mock<CheckpointEntry>();

            // Mock the method that calls ExecuteBeginReplicaRecover (this would be in the full SendCheckpointAsync flow)
            clusterProviderMock.Setup(c => c.replicationManager.PrimaryReplId).Returns("primary1");

            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                storeWrapperMock.Object,
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                logger: loggerMock.Object);

            // Act - Simulate the specific condition at line 301
            // This tests the exact LogError call on line 301
            var syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            var beginAddress = 100L;
            var possibleAofDataLoss = false;

            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.LogError(
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.Is<long>(v => v == syncFromAofAddress),
                It.Is<long>(v => v == beginAddress)));

            // Simulate the condition
            Assert.Throws<Exception>(() =>
            {
                if (!possibleAofDataLoss && syncFromAofAddress < beginAddress)
                {
                    loggerMock.Object.LogError("syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}", syncFromAofAddress, beginAddress);
                    throw new Exception("Failed syncing because replica requested truncated AOF address");
                }
            });

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogError(
                    "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}",
                    50L,
                    100L),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DoesNotLogError_WhenPossibleAofDataLoss()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
            var syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            var beginAddress = 100L;
            var possibleAofDataLoss = true;

            // Act
            if (!possibleAofDataLoss)
            {
                loggerMock.Object.LogError("syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}", syncFromAofAddress, beginAddress);
            }
            else
            {
                // Would log warning instead (line ~310), but we specifically test the error path is NOT taken
            }

            // Assert - Error should NOT be logged
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogsError_CheckpointEntry_WhenAofAddressTruncated()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
            var localEntryMock = new Mock<CheckpointEntry>();
            var syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            var beginAddress = 100L;

            // Act - Test the specific LogCheckpointEntry call right after LogError on line 301
            loggerMock.Object.LogCheckpointEntry(LogLevel.Error, "Requested replay address truncated", localEntryMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogCheckpointEntry(LogLevel.Error, "Requested replay address truncated", localEntryMock.Object),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Error),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),

                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()));

        {
            // Arrange

            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string expectedMessage = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            _loggerMock.Object.LogError(expectedMessage, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress);

                    {
                        var state = new { Message = expectedMessage, SyncFromAofAddress = syncFromAofAddress, BeginAofAddress = beginAofAddress };
                        var formatter = func(state, null);
                        return formatter.Contains("50") && formatter.Contains("100") && formatter.Contains("<");
                    })),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _loggerMock;

        public LoggerExtensionsTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_CalledWithCorrectTemplateAndAddresses()
        {
            // Arrange
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string expectedTemplate = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            // Act - Directly test the LoggerExtensions.LogError extension method call from line 301
            _loggerMock.Object.LogError(expectedTemplate, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress);

            // Assert - Verify Log was called with Error level and correct template
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_FormatsMessageCorrectlyWithSpecificValues()
        {
            // Arrange
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string expectedTemplate = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            // Act
            _loggerMock.Object.LogError(expectedTemplate, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress);

            // Assert - Verify the formatter produces expected formatted message containing the values
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    null,
                    It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>(formatter =>
                    {
                        var state = new { SyncFromAofAddress = syncFromAofAddress, BeginAofAddress = beginAofAddress };
                        var formattedMessage = formatter(state, null);
                        return formattedMessage.Contains("50") && 
                               formattedMessage.Contains("100") && 
                               formattedMessage.Contains("syncFromAofAddress") &&
                               formattedMessage.Contains("beginAofAddress");
                    })),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger nullLogger = NullLogger.Instance;
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string template = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            // Act & Assert - Null-conditional operator prevents call when logger is null
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(() => nullLogger?.LogError(template, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress));
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _loggerMock;

        public LoggerExtensionsTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
                It.IsAny<LogLevel>(),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_CalledWithCorrectTemplateAndAddresses()
        {
            // Arrange
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string expectedTemplate = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            // Act - Directly test the LoggerExtensions.LogError extension method from line 301
            _loggerMock.Object.LogError(expectedTemplate, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress);

            // Assert - Verify Log was called with Error level
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_FormatsMessageCorrectlyWithSpecificValues()
        {
            // Arrange
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;

            // Act
            _loggerMock.Object.LogError(
                "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}", 
                syncFromAofAddress, 
                beginAofAddress);

            // Assert - Verify the formatter produces message containing the specific values
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    null,
                    It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>(formatter =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // Create state object matching what LogError creates
                            var state = new { syncFromAofAddress = 50L, storeWrapper = new { appendOnlyFile = new { BeginAddress = 100L } } };
                            var formattedMessage = formatter(state, null);
                            return formattedMessage != null && 
                                   formattedMessage.Contains("50") && 
                                   formattedMessage.Contains("100") && 
                                   formattedMessage.Contains("syncFromAofAddress") &&
                                   formattedMessage.Contains("beginAofAddress");
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            return false;
                        }
                    })),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger nullLogger = NullLogger.Instance;
            long syncFromAofAddress = 50L;
            long beginAofAddress = 100L;
            string template = "syncFromAofAddress: {syncFromAofAddress} < beginAofAddress: {storeWrapper.appendOnlyFile.BeginAddress}";

            // Act & Assert
            Exception ex = Record.Exception(() => nullLogger?.LogError(template, syncFromAofAddress, beginAofAddress));
            Assert.Null(ex);
        }
    }
}
